# CLI setup and conversation-first release

Verified 13 October 2026. Development preview, not a complete product or signed installer.

## Open

Keep the entire portable folder together and open:

`C:\Users\alexk\OneDrive\Documents\GitHub\Arcane\runtime\windows\arcane-win32-x64-XZ40Kh\Arcane.exe`

- Charcoal/red conversation-first workspace; preview hidden by default, manual toggle and per-job asset-driven opening.
- Searchable composer model/effort picker from native metadata only; selection waits for acknowledgement. No invented models or entitlement claims.
- Settings → Provider setup: explicit status checks, confirmed vendor login terminal, official installation instructions, and unmodified Claude Code terminal handoff. No automatic installation or startup login probes.
- Explicit disconnect/reconnect path for a previously signed-out session after native login, preserving the draft and never silently starting a thread.

## Remaining boundaries

Real vendor login/install/terminal handoffs have synthetic safety tests, not live interaction acceptance. Claude is not an inline subscription proxy or mirrored-history implementation. Native inference, configured-thread/tool isolation, Studio/plugin live edits/recovery, full image/design/asset/animation feature coverage, and skill behavior acceptance remain unverified/deferred. Full product completion is not claimed. See [first run](FIRST_RUN.md).
